title: The Old Light F7 - The Winding Room
_note: Old Light top floor (pearlmoor_oldlight_top), Punchwheel's winding room: full derangement that still loops. The theme runs in 8 four-bar phrases, each a minor third HIGHER than the last (F -> Ab -> B -> D, then the spring snaps back to F - a lead "boing" glide D6->F4 at the end of each winding - so the seam is just one more snap). Every phrase LURCHES: either drag-then-rush (its first bar augmented to half speed, the rest crammed into double time) or rush-then-drag, with the oom-pah stretching and squashing to match; under it a clockwork ratchet of hats accelerates quarters -> 8ths -> 16ths -> 16th-triplets each phrase (the wind-up). Each phrase's 4th bar stacks THREE laughs - pulse12 in key, a low pulse25 a tritone off, a bell a semitone off - and a double pfft. 144 BPM, 4/4, keys cycling by minor thirds from F, 32 bars.
